description: Read shop, item, order, refund, and logistics data through the Youzan Cloud API.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID of a Youzan self-use app. Find it in the Youzan Cloud console: https://doc.youzanyun.com/v2/doc/cloud/token/StTtweZjrirPBKknYjXcwNoynNh.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret of a Youzan self-use app. Find it with the Client ID in the Youzan Cloud console: https://doc.youzanyun.com/v2/doc/cloud/token/StTtweZjrirPBKknYjXcwNoynNh.

fields.label: Store ID (kdt_id)
fields.description: The Youzan store ID authorized to the self-use app. See how to find the kdt_id: https://doc.youzanyun.com/v2/doc/kdt_id.

actions.name: get_item
actions.description: Get a Youzan item by its item ID.

inputSchema.description: The item identifier used to retrieve a Youzan item.

item.description: A Youzan item record. Available fields depend on the store type and enabled capabilities.

actions.name: get_order
actions.description: Get a Youzan order by its order ID.

inputSchema.description: The order identifier used to retrieve a Youzan order.

order.description: A Youzan order record. Available fields depend on the order type and enabled capabilities.

actions.name: get_order_logistics
actions.description: Get all express or local-delivery packages and tracking details for a Youzan order.

sourceId.description: The Youzan order source: 1001 for catering or 1002 for other stores. Defaults to 1002.

inputSchema.description: The order identifier used to retrieve Youzan logistics packages.

items.description: A Youzan logistics package with express or local-delivery details.

packages.description: The logistics packages associated with the order.

actions.name: get_refund
actions.description: Get a Youzan refund or after-sale record by its refund ID.

includeAllConsultMessages.description: Whether to include all buyer and seller consultation messages.

inputSchema.description: The refund identifier used to retrieve a Youzan refund.

refund.description: A Youzan refund record. Available fields depend on the after-sale type and current status.

actions.name: get_shop
actions.description: Get the identity and basic profile of the connected Youzan shop.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to retrieve the connected Youzan shop.

shop.description: A Youzan shop record. Available fields depend on the store type and enabled capabilities.

actions.name: list_inventory_items
actions.description: List shelved or sold-out items from a Youzan store inventory.

status.description: The inventory section to query. Defaults to for_shelved.

query.description: A keyword matched against the item title.

orderBy.description: The inventory result sort field and direction.

updatedAfter.description: The earliest item update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updatedBefore.description: The latest item update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

nodeKdtId.description: The child store kdt_id used in a chain-store query.

page.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: The number of inventory items per page. Defaults to 40 and cannot exceed 300.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to list Youzan inventory items.

items.description: A Youzan item record. Available fields depend on the store type and enabled capabilities.

total.description: The total number of matching items reported by Youzan.

pageSize.description: The requested number of items per page.

actions.name: list_onsale_items
actions.description: List items currently visible for sale in a Youzan online or physical store.

kdtId.description: The Youzan store kdt_id. Defaults to the store ID in the connection credential.

channel.description: The sales channel: 0 for an online store or 1 for a physical store. Defaults to 0.

title.description: A keyword matched against the item title.

itemIds.description: The Youzan item IDs to include.

itemCodes.description: The merchant item codes to include.

updatedAfter.description: The earliest item update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updatedBefore.description: The latest item update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

page.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: The number of on-sale items per page. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 50.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to list items currently visible for sale in a Youzan store.

items.description: A Youzan item record. Available fields depend on the store type and enabled capabilities.

total.description: The total number of matching items reported by Youzan.

pageSize.description: The requested number of items per page.

outputSchema.description: A paginated Youzan on-sale item result.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List Youzan orders using status, time, item, delivery, and text filters.

status.description: The Youzan order status to include.

keywords.description: A general order search value such as an order ID or receiver phone suffix.

itemId.description: A Youzan item ID included in the order.

createdAfter.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

createdBefore.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

updatedAfter.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

updatedBefore.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

completedAfter.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

completedBefore.description: A Youzan date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format.

nodeKdtId.description: The child store kdt_id used in a chain-store query.

page.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1 and cannot exceed 100.

pageSize.description: The number of orders per page. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 100.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to list Youzan orders.

items.description: A Youzan order record. Available fields depend on the order type and enabled capabilities.

total.description: The total number of matching orders reported by Youzan.

pageSize.description: The requested number of orders per page.

actions.name: list_refunds
actions.description: List Youzan refund and after-sale records using order, status, and time filters.

demand.description: The buyer demand: 1 for refund only, 2 for return and refund, or 3 for exchange.

createdAfter.description: The earliest refund creation time to include, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

createdBefore.description: The latest refund creation time to include, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updatedAfter.description: The earliest refund update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

updatedBefore.description: The latest refund update time to include, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

nodeKdtId.description: The child store kdt_id used in a chain-store query.

page.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1 and cannot exceed 100.

pageSize.description: The number of refund records per page. Defaults to 20.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to list Youzan after-sale refund records.

items.description: A Youzan refund record. Available fields depend on the after-sale type and current status.

total.description: The total number of matching refunds reported by Youzan.

pageSize.description: The requested number of refunds per page.
